title: 第25章 下注第26章同行
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
随着另一拨人的加入，场面顿时变得更加混乱不堪。
周围的摊贩和原本驻足看热闹的行人。
被这刀光剑影，喊杀喊打的阵势吓得纷纷抱头鼠窜，尖叫声哭喊声不绝于耳。
倒是一旁的白露，看得越发津津有味。
甚至还有闲情逸致从油纸包里抓出一把香气扑鼻的炒瓜子。
递给同样缩在她身旁躲避的瑶娘。
瑶娘看着那素白玉手中递来的瓜子，眼神古怪地瞥了白露一眼。
都这种时候了，还有心思嗑瓜子？
瑶娘连忙拒绝，并且将白露的手往回推了推：“你吃吧，我不吃。”
她生怕接了这瓜子，自己也会变得这般……呆傻。
见对方不领情，白露只好悻悻然收回手，自顾自地“咔嚓咔嚓”磕了起来。
就是眼前这层碍事的白纱帷帽，有点影响她发挥……
她下意识地抬手拨了拨面前垂落的轻纱。
此时，那边几十个人的混战也出现了一面倒的局面。
没办法，谁让修士的体质就是比凡人的强横很多呢。
就算练了凡间武艺，生出了内力，达到了先天，那又怎样？
也只能算是武者。
无法踏入练气，那就只能算是普通人。
很快，裴初晟带来的十几个护卫便被打得鼻青脸肿，哀嚎着瘫倒在地，痛哭流涕。
至于那裴初晟倒还是硬气的梗着脖子。

好像完全不怕那被抵在脖子上的森冷长剑一样。
他屈辱地跪在地上，脖子却像是梗出了二里地一样地叫嚷：“我姐可是皇贵妃！你们敢动我……”
这话一出，白露唇边又忍不住逸出一声轻嗤
只要作为一个现代人，听到这样类似的句子，真的很难不会被笑出来。
毕竟“我爸是李刚。”这个梗曾在网络上火了很久。
听见白露又发出了一声不明的轻笑。
在她旁边的瑶娘顿时又脸色奇怪的向着旁边移了移。
这次，裴初晟没空理会白露的笑声了。
因为他清晰地感觉到，脖子上那冰凉的剑，已经刺破了他的皮肤！
在感受到皮肤上传来的一丝濡湿时。
裴初晟的脸色终于变了。
他知道自己恐怕是遇到了硬茬。
但就在他准备痛哭流涕的求饶时。
地面突然传来一阵轻微的震动，伴随着整齐划一铿锵作响的轻甲碰撞声！
一道中气十足的大喝也从远处传来：“何人敢在天子脚下闹事！”
不一会，几队身着褐色轻甲手持长矛的士兵便将现场团团围住！
“本都尉倒要看看，是谁在武阳城撒野！”
一个身着黑色轻甲、面容刚毅，手持红缨长枪骑着高大枣红骏马的男人出现在众人视线中，气势威严。
在看见这个人的刹那，裴初晟就像是看到了救星一样大喊了起来：“程都尉你总算来了。”
“这群贱民竟然想当众刺杀我。”

“快把他们都抓起来……”
然而，当程都尉锐利的目光扫过季九思身上的衣袍，尤其是他腰间那枚剑形白玉佩时。
瞳孔骤然一缩，仿佛看到了什么极其可怖的事物！
竟然是……
一个念头如闪电般划过脑海，程都尉脸色剧变，慌忙翻身下马，冲到季九思面前。
content_en:
As another group of people joined in, the scene suddenly became more chaotic.
The surrounding vendors and pedestrians who had stopped to watch the excitement.
Frightened by the flash of swords and the shouts of killing and beating, they all ran away with their heads in their hands, and screams and cries could not be heard.
On the other hand, Bai Lu on the side watched with increasing interest.
There is even a leisurely moment to grab a handful of fragrant fried melon seeds from the oil paper bag.
Passed it to Yao Niang who was also hiding beside her.
Yao Niang looked at the melon seeds handed to her by the plain white jade hand, and glanced at Bai Lu strangely.
It’s a time like this, but you still want to eat melon seeds?
Yao Niang quickly refused and pushed Bai Lu's hand back: "You can eat it, I won't."
She was afraid that if she took this melon seed, she would become so... stupid.
Seeing that the other party was not appreciative, Bai Lu had no choice but to withdraw her hand angrily and start knocking on her own.
It was the obstructive white gauze curtain in front of her that somewhat affected her performance...
She subconsciously raised her hand to pluck the gauze hanging in front of her.
At this time, the melee between dozens of people over there also turned into a one-sided situation.
There is no way around it. The physique of a monk is much stronger than that of a mortal.
Even if you practice mortal martial arts, develop inner strength, and achieve innateness, so what?
He can only be regarded as a warrior.
If you can't step into Qi training, you can only be regarded as an ordinary person.
Soon, the dozen or so guards brought by Pei Chusheng were beaten until their noses were bruised and their faces were swollen. They collapsed to the ground wailing and crying.
As for Pei Chusheng, he was still holding his neck stiffly.
It seemed as if he was not afraid of the cold sword being pressed against his neck.
He knelt on the ground in humiliation, but his neck seemed to be stretched out for two miles and shouted: "My sister is the imperial concubine! How dare you touch me..."
As soon as these words came out, Bai Lu couldn't help but let out a soft sneer from her lips.
As a modern person, it is really hard not to laugh when you hear sentences like this.
After all, "My dad is Li Gang." This meme has been popular on the Internet for a long time.
I heard Bai Lu let out another unknown chuckle.
Yao Niang, who was next to her, suddenly moved to the side with a strange expression on her face.
This time, Pei Chusheng had no time to pay attention to Bai Lu's laughter.
Because he clearly felt that the cold sword on his neck had pierced his skin!
When I feel a touch of wetness on my skin.
Pei Chusheng's expression finally changed.
He knew that he might have encountered a tough situation.
But just when he was about to cry and beg for mercy.
Suddenly there was a slight vibration on the ground, accompanied by the clanging sound of light armor!
A powerful shout also came from a distance: "Who dares to make trouble at the feet of the Emperor!"
After a while, several groups of soldiers wearing brown light armor and holding spears surrounded the scene!
"I would like to see who is running wild in Wuyang City!"
A man wearing black light armor with a resolute face, holding a red tassel spear and riding a tall maroon horse appeared in everyone's sight, looking majestic.
The moment he saw this man, Pei Chusheng shouted as if he had seen a savior: "Captain Cheng, you are finally here."
"These untouchables actually want to assassinate me in public."
"Catch them all quickly..."
However, Captain Cheng's sharp gaze swept across Ji Jiusi's robes, especially the sword-shaped white jade pendant around his waist.
His pupils suddenly shrank, as if he had seen something extremely terrifying!
It turned out to be...
A thought flashed through his mind like lightning, and Captain Cheng's expression changed drastically. He hurriedly got off his horse and rushed to Ji Jiusi.
